scope: actual Go client, private file:// fixtures; no Nexus, HTTP or public checksum lookup

checks.name: own canonical calculation matches real Go Sum and GoModSum
different ZIP bytes and order accepted with the same trusted go.sum
known go.sum rejects changed content even with GONOSUMDB exemption
no known sum and no external private checksum trust accepts first received content
filenames participate in the canonical hash

limitations: Not a module ZIP validator for arbitrary inputs
Nexus and remote checksum database not executed
Checksums establish consistency against trusted expectations, not source code safety
